title: Problems for not Having Aadhaar
description: In this video, Meghavath Sathish and Nenavath Mohan, both from Telangana, India, and speakers of the Lambadi language, discuss Aadhaar, the Indian digital ID, in the context of their community life. They were interviewed on the 4th September, 2019, in Hyderabad, Telangana, by Subhashish Panigrahi, a Baleswari-Odia-language speaker, for the documentary film MarginalizedAadhaar. The interview was subtitled in Hindi at the location by Panigrahi, based on a verbatim translation by Meghavath and Nenavath. Footage, some of which was used in the film, and subtitles were edited and translated into English by Panigrahi, and were published under the OpenSpeaks Archives project in 2026.
